name: 质保索赔管理 - 供应商摊回处理 (5HR)
name_en: Warranty Claim Management – Supplier Recovery Processing (5HR)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scenario lets you to create a warranty claim that can then be forwarded to the respective supplier for a reimbursement. The scenario covers the relevant steps starting with creating a claim (based on a performed repair), validating for completeness, determining eligibility for reimbursement, and finding the correct prices for material, labor activities, and so on.

Once the information is sent to the supplier and their response is received, the scenario supports the transparent maintenance of values and the posting of the negotiated amount.

Key Process Flow

  • Create, validate, and adjust claims
  • Set parts return relevance and check execution
  • Send claim to supplier
  • Maintain supplier's response
  • Post claim
  • Reverse posting
  • Reject, cancel, and close claims

Business Benefits

  • Increase your supplier recovery rate by easily creating claim for repairs, using the already available information in your system (materials, prices, and so on)
  • Save time and increase supplier satisfaction by only raising and sending out valid claims that are likely to get paid (by validating the claims with regards to master data and eligibility)
  • Keep transparency on requested and reimbursed amounts with the versioning concept and directly post the respective amounts to the appropriate accounts
description_zh_html:
概览

此场景允许您创建担保索赔，然后将其转发给相应的供应商进行报销。该场景涵盖从创建索赔（基于已执行的维修）、验证完整性、确定报销资格以及查找物料、人工活动的正确价格等开始的相关步骤。

将信息发送给供应商并收到其响应后，场景支持透明的值维护和协商金额的过账。

关键流程流

  • 创建、验证和调整索赔
  • 设置部件退货相关性并检查执行
  • 向供应商发送索赔
  • 维护供应商的响应
  • 过账索赔
  • 冲销过账
  • 拒绝、取消并关闭索赔

业务优势

  • 使用系统中现有的信息（物料、价格等）轻松创建维修索赔，从而提高供应商回收率
  • 通过仅提出和发送可能获得付款的有效索赔（通过验证与主数据和资格相关的索赔）来节省时间并提高供应商满意度
  • 使用版本化概念保持申请和报销金额的透明度，并直接将相应金额过账到相应科目
